method: Real WASD plus native captured joystick for fine corner control; Chromium touch emulation, NOT a physical device. Two independent crossings, each four continuous out/return walk/run legs after its own initial review spawn. Original Shift speed, no overrides. Stop at every outward waypoint including landings and narrow section; real left/right and toward-rail input at midpoint. No in-movement teleport/collision override or movement-speed changes. A* gives intended waypoints; native contact and rendered-body evidence reported separately.

legs.failure: Native joystick unavailable for real fine input
